Two authored defects remain: q-32629 does not restrict the quadratic's domain, so g has no global inverse; its selected derivative formula is correct for either invertible branch, away from the vertex. q-8477 mistakenly mentions x4 while listing only three solutions; its requested product is correct. Mathematical checks: q-18285 has determinant -2 and cofactor c13=-2, giving inverse entry 1. q-8477 has solutions π/6, π/2, 5π/6, giving product 5π²/12. q-65851 has solutions -3π/2 and π/2, whose sum is -π. q-3300 uses the inverse derivative formula 1/g'(g⁻¹(x)), with g'(t)=12t²+2. q-32629 uses the same formula with g'(t)=4t+6, subject to the branch qualification above. q-81823 maps v to -v, pointing steeply down and right. q-160626 maps (a,b) to (-b,a), rotating v 90 degrees counterclockwise to point slightly upward and right. Each selected image matches its source solution's red vector; the source images additionally display the original blue vector. q-65807 follows from the arcsine range [-π/2,π/2]. q-117010 includes II and III: arcsin(0)=0 and arcsin(-1)=-π/2, whereas arcsin(√3/2)=π/3, not 2π/3. q-11726 requires n²-16=0. q-127901 requires 144-a²=0. q-170558 reduces to -3x²=1, so there are no real intersections; the source's statement about negative square roots should be understood over the reals. q-159976 is verified by T(4,8)=(4,0). q-141112 gives A=(-2)(-1)=2. q-14680 has tangent slope -1/3 and equation y=-x/3+4/3, giving intercept (0,4/3). q-85069 has area factor |8·3-5·(-2)|=34. No captured grades were supplied; all MA answer evidence below comes from each question's own worked solution.",
